answer: The umber schedule is applied in willow and ocean exposes each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1243 identities would post 3834 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
